title.narrative: Protection & Support of Enabling Environment for W

description.narrative: This project addresses critical land tenure insecurity and governance challenges in Lofa, Liberia, specifically targeting the ecologically sensitive Wologisi Mountain area where forest ecosystems face increasing threats from unsustainable land use and extractive activities amid inadequate enforcement of environmental and climate change regulations. By formalizing customary land rights and strengthening community governance capacity, the project strategically positions local communities to engage from a position of secured land tenure and enhanced negotiating power with future investors or government entities interested in natural resource extraction in the area. It also provides gender senstivie training to the community, and embeds gender quotas into its structures to ensure women are fully included in land management, which was not happening previously.
